explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 1468 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the promethazine hydrochloride shortage on 2023-11-21 and it has remained on the list for 35 months as of 2026-10-21.
Our Corvale General inventory includes product from Zydus Lifesciences Limited (NDC 65841004110) and PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NDC 43063040505).
The Zydus Lifesciences Limited plant (FEI 3002984011) on that label received an OAI classification letter dated 2019-11-14, which was 1468 days before the shortage posting.
That same plant also received an earlier OAI classification letter dated 2016-06-09, 2721 days before the posting.
The PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. plant (FEI 1641825) on our other label has only VAI inspections, most recently ending 2026-08-20.
The highest-ranked action by rule is to transfer 9 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, which would give Corvale Lakeside 14 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks of supply.

Q-e34ae1.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%promethazine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%promethazine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-af7a23.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('81fd29a9-c090-49ba-8b48-bd3656ca0c92', '4eaa8291-9cde-4205-857b-925ea8d618ba') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-5a67ad.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%promethazine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-fc5d96.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%promethazine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-10b1a9.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%promethazine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-e1bd93.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('zydus lifesciences', 'pd rx') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%promethazine%' ORDER BY initiation_date
